label: The plague is linked to obesity, diabetes and heart disease
description: He says the coming plague that kills 350 million worldwide and 30 million in America is linked to obesity, diabetes and heart disease, and gives this as the reason he was warned to change how he lives so he could live long and finish his assignment. Given 8 April 2024.
aliases: linked to diabetes and heart disease

label: Drones that sense body heat hunting those without the mark
description: Drones flying everywhere across America, through woods and over oceans, audible as they approach, sensing body heat and motion, with the mark in the hand or forehead reporting back to them who has taken it. From the 2023 tribulation vision.
aliases: they could sense your body heat
would report back to them that you had it
